prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If the object is approached, then retrieve it and process it.  If not, then approach it.  If the object is not visible, then scan the area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ProcessObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = RetrieveItem    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessItem    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsItemVisible    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = GrabObject    />     <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> </Sequence> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsItemVisible    />     <Action ID = ApproachItem    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanAreaForItem    />"
code:
SELECTOR
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsItemApproached? THEN
				DO RetrieveItem
		ELSE
			DO ProcessItem
		END
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsItemVisible? THEN
				DO ApproachItem
		END
		DO ScanAreaForItem
	END
